name: pardesline
description: PardesLine: 3D vision and medical imaging in one Python package, run locally. Skills that teach an agent the catalog, the object model, datasets by manifest and the cloud client.

plugins.name: pardesline
plugins.description: Skills for the pardesline package: run the 73 algorithms locally with validated parameters, chain them on typed objects that keep frame/units/labels/licence/provenance, load public datasets or private folders by manifest, work with medical volumes, use the optional cloud client, and extend the package.
